Messages.Author: Robert Courtney Campbell
Messages.Body:
Okay, guys, mull on this one for a second. I've got a friend of mine, name
of Jeff Stephens. Soon as DS comes out, he starts trading like mad for
force of wills. I'm confused. No big deal. He comes up with this deck,
right? I play him with this deck he builds. He whips out Camille Deveraux
and bleads me with her. I block. Form of mist. He gets the edge. Force of
Will. I wake. He forms of mist. I'm bled again. He goes to torpor.
Movement of the slow body. Rapid healing. He comes out of topor with all
his blood on him and guess what he does? FORCE OF WILL AGAIN. No more
wakes for me. I'm bled. torpor-movement-rap.healing-FORCE OF WILL AGAIN!!!
In no less than six turns, he'd gone through me, my prey, and my prey's
prey. He never blocks. He bleeds you six times a turn with the same
friggin dude. And get this--when he doesn't have the cards to run the
combo, HE GETS THEM BACK WITH CARLOTTA GIOVANI!

prety slick, huh??



With Carlotta Giovanni (as in his example), it doesn't matter if Form of
Mist is restricted.

6 Form of Mists (as done with the restricted Tournament Rules), is
sufficient to run a deck based on this idea. See my example in another
thread (Re: How Big Should the CL be?). Repeated actions are broken.

twice a turn regardless of subsuquent untaps...) completely ends this
kind of gross combo.

Messages.Author: REF
Messages.Body:
gac...@ix.netcom.com(GC ) wrote:

>1. I think this is the card that allows you to have three more rounds
>of combat if you are going to torpor. The question: if you don't have
>any blood left and are supposed to go to topor, but you play this card
>and continue combat another 3 rounds, what happens when you take normal
>damage or agg. damage?

>One more question:
>2. If in the first round of combat is manuvered out to long range by a
>player, will the second round of combat be at long range (as long as no
>other manuvers are played)?

>-rhee

Question #1
You are correct on the card, but not that it only gives one press so
you need another source of presses (trap works well) to continue.
Damage is assessed normally but you will not go to Torpor until the
effect from the card ends. So normal damage will subtract blood if
any is left on the vampire. Agg does the same but note that if the
vampire is shy of blood this card does not prevent the vampire from
being burned.

Question #2
No, each round starts at close range and requires a maneuver to move
it to long.
Rory
